topic.title: The 0.38% average US savings rate against the Fed's 4%: one balance, two accounts

title: Savings at 0.38% while the Fed sits at 4%: what the gap costs you
description: The FDIC puts the average US savings account rate at 0.38% in October, while the top of the Fed's target range is 4%. We work out what $10,000 earns at the average rate and at an assumed 4% over 1 year and 5 years. Data: FDIC, Federal Reserve. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
